messages:
lina: Customer (Acme) reports rerank returns a 413 / 'Payload too large' when sending ~120 docs. They say their docs aren't huge individually, thinks it's token limit. Can someone triage?

sam: Can you paste the exact request body (redact PII/keys) and response body? Also which model/version are they calling?

lina: yup pasted below — they used model: rerank-large-v2, content trimmed but structure the same:

```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\n    "query": "<very long user query text ~ 9000 chars>",\n    "documents": [\n      {"id": "d1", "text": "<doc text ~ 2400 chars>"},\n      {"id": "d2", "text": "<doc text ~ 2300 chars>"},\n      ... // total ~120 docs\n    ]\n  }'\n```

support-bot: POST /v1/rerank 413 {"error":"Payload too large"} :triage

ark: 413 makes sense — our rerank endpoint enforces a combined token/char cap for query+all docs before encoding. With 120 docs + a long query you hit the prefix/KV memory and tokenization ceiling. The error today is generic.

ark: Quick checklist to repro locally: 1) use same model (rerank-large-v2); 2) construct a query ~9k chars and batch ~120 docs ~2-3k chars each; 3) send as single rerank request. Should reproduce the 413.

sam: Also note: some customers see a 500 or 'unexpected scores' if truncation happens downstream. We should check whether the pipeline short-circuits or returns structured 413.

lina: Acme saw 413 in logs. They asked if we can return a clearer message explaining 'docs+query exceed X tokens' and suggest chunking. They've asked for guidance to implement client-side chunking.

ark: Proposed user-facing error payload: 

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "RERANK_INPUT_TOO_LARGE",
    "message": "Combined token length of query + documents exceeds limit for rerank (limit: 24576 tokens). Reduce number of documents or truncate documents/query.",
    "limit_tokens": 24576
  }
}
```

ark: For client guidance — recommend either: 1) limit docs per request (e.g., <= 50), 2) truncate documents to first N chars (e.g., 1.5k chars), or 3) do two-stage pipeline: embed & candidate-filter (cheap) then rerank top-K.

natalie: +1 to structured error with code. Can we add a 'suggested_action' field with short instructions and a link to a KB page? That will reduce support churn.

lina: I'll send Acme a short triage reply and share a quick chunking snippet.

lina: Snippet for client-side trimming we can paste: 

```python
# naive truncation before rerank
MAX_DOC_CHARS = 1500
max_docs = 50
trimmed_docs = [ {"id": d["id"], "text": d["text"][:MAX_DOC_CHARS]} for d in docs][:max_docs]
payload = {"query": query[:4000], "documents": trimmed_docs}
```

sam: For prod: arch question — should we fail fast with 413 + structured body, or attempt to rerank a truncated subset and warn? I prefer fail-fast so callers can control truncation.

ark: Agreed fail-fast. Automatically truncating could silently change ranking results and confuse customers.

natalie: Action items: 
- lina: reply to customer with repro steps + snippet (owner)
- ark: open doc PR for error payload and suggested client patterns (owner)
- sam: check logs for any 500s tied to truncation and add alert if seen (owner)
- product (natalie): consider including 'recommended_max_docs' per model in model catalog

lina: I'll reply now and include the curl repro + suggested error wording and the python snippet.

sam: If you need a quick local reproduce script I can drop one in #eng-ml.

lina: Thanks — will loop back after Acme confirms. :+1:

support-bot: Ticket created: SUP-4421 (linked to customer Acme)

ark: small note for docs: include exact numeric token limits per rerank model (token calculator example) and show sample chunking patterns (sliding window vs head-only).

natalie: tagging @docs to pick this up.

lina: update: Acme confirms repro with the trimmed example and will implement chunking. Closing on our side once docs PR lands. :white_check_mark:
